subject: general
question: Which of the following are parts of the peripheral nervous system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both cranial and spinal nerves**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The peripheral nervous system (PNS) consists of all the nerves that lie outside the brain and spinal cord.
 
• It includes 12 pairs of cranial nerves and 31 pairs of spinal nerves.
 
• The cranial nerves originate from the brain and primarily serve the head and neck region.
 
• The spinal nerves originate from the spinal cord and serve the rest of the body.
 
• The PNS is responsible for transmitting sensory and motor information to and from the central nervous system (CNS).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Nervous System (CNS)**

 
 
• It consists of the brain and spinal cord.
 
• The CNS is responsible for processing and interpreting sensory information and sending out instructions.
 
 
 
• **Autonomic Nervous System (ANS)**
 
 
• It is a part of the PNS that controls involuntary bodily functions.
 
• The ANS is divided into the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems.
 
 
 
• **Somatic Nervous System**
 
 
• It is another part of the PNS that controls voluntary movements.
 
• The somatic nervous system transmits sensory and motor signals to and from the CNS.
 
 
 
• **Neurons**
 
 
• They are the basic building blocks of the nervous system.
 
• Neurons transmit information through electrical and chemical signals.
